facts.fact: The Ministry of Health calls DHIS2 the reference tool of Gabon's national health information system, used by public, private and faith-based facilities to transmit health data.
Gabonreview reports eGabon-SIS deployed the health information system in 13 civilian and military pilot hospitals, and the government's roadmap commits to extending it progressively.

The health ministry is rolling out its eGabon-SIS health information system, live in two pilot hospitals since a phase one provisionally accepted on 20 December 2024, with eight more hospitals entering production from July 2025, and the minister says it will give real-time data for steering public health.
